description: Chairs and branches crisscross the reflections around the parrot as it leans toward the book.
impression: With so much going on around it, the parrot's small lean toward the book gives my eye somewhere to settle.

description: The dog lies quietly behind the door under shelves packed with little things.
impression: My eye comes to rest on the dog after wandering over all the objects above it.

description: A little yellow breaks up the gray of two birds sitting quietly against the window bars.
impression: The subdued feathers seem to suit how still the birds are against those bars.

description: The bottle label and the cat's whiskers come into focus together as the cat leans close.
impression: It's the small gap between the whiskers and the label that makes the cat's lean so noticeable.

description: There is little behind the resting gray pigeon to distract from its outline on the ledge.
impression: The soft background leaves the still pigeon alone on that diagonal, all in quiet gray tones.

description: The shadows leave just the pale face of the resting cat to look at.
impression: So little else shows in the shadow that the still, lightly colored face holds my eye.

description: Against that plain soft background, the tiny bird's open red bill jumps out from its bright green feathers.
impression: There's almost nothing behind the bird to compete with that flash of red against green.

description: The pale and dark horses frame the riders sitting still in this black-and-white scene.
impression: Without any color, the contrast between the horses stands out more than anything the seated riders are doing.

description: The rich gold of the table shows between tightly packed plates, glasses and little bird shapes.
impression: The gold ties the jostle of dishes and little shapes together, even where there's hardly a gap between them.

description: The zebras' stripes stretch across the grassy ground as the animals break into a run.
impression: The grass gives the racing zebras a backdrop without drawing much attention from their stride.

description: The green water makes a backdrop for the heron's long neck as it stands still at the edge.
impression: I notice the line of the water's edge and then the heron standing so quietly against the green.

description: Soft foliage picks up the quiet tones of the giraffe's patterned neck as it rests.
impression: The giraffe is so still that I notice the patches on its neck and the faint colors around them first.

description: The crane's gray feathers give the brilliant blue hydrant and green lawn something to stand out against.
impression: The lawn and hydrant make an unexpectedly vivid setting for that gray crane.

description: Against the warm browns of the room, the kitten leans just far enough to touch noses with the dog.
impression: The room's gentle browns set off that small nose-to-nose gesture without overpowering it.

description: The still bird's little patch of blue nearly disappears in a mesh of gray branches.
impression: I had to pick the resting bird out of the tangle; even its blue is quiet among those grays.

description: The elephant faces the camera beneath its rider, filling the narrow view with shades of gray.
impression: The rider gives my eye a second place to go in a frame mostly taken up by the elephant's gray form.

description: Layers of glossy leaves close in around the bird sitting quietly between them.
impression: The leaves overlap so thickly that the still bird looks tucked into them.

description: As people lead a horse across the field, the tent and crowd behind keep pulling the eye away.
impression: The horse's measured progress is easy to lose among all the people and the tent.

description: The forward-facing bird's drooping brown feathers almost match the dusty ground.
impression: Earthy tones tie the ground to the bird, leaving its forward gaze and drooping outline to draw attention.

description: In patches of shade beneath the trees, one zebra rests while the other stands nearby.
impression: The trees break up the light around the zebras, but neither animal is doing much.

description: A stretch of blue water leaves the lone heron clearly outlined as it stands still by the grass.
impression: With only grass and water to frame it, the heron's stillness is hard to miss.

description: As the giraffe bends to drink, its reddish patches stand out sharply against the green grass.
impression: The bend of the neck brings that vivid red and green contrast right down to the grass.

description: Two white necks curve across one another as the nearer swan dips its orange bill.
impression: That small dip of the bill helps me follow one white neck through the overlap with the other.

description: The upright grass blades frame the face of a puppy at rest among them.
impression: Most of the resting puppy is lost in the tall grass, leaving its face to catch the eye.
